_comment: DEDICATED settings for the HEADLESS Claude Code spawned by tools/relay/code_relay.py via `claude -p --settings .claude/relay-agent.settings.json`. NOT auto-loaded by the interactive seat (only settings.json / settings.local.json auto-load), so it never changes the founder's interactive permissions. WHY a full deny set (locked decision #3, 2026-06-13): a headless run from this repo UNIONS the permissive allow-lists in .claude/settings.json AND .claude/settings.local.json (both allow `git push`, plus local allows `gh api`, `node -e`, `pnpm *`, `python *`...). Claude Code lets DENY override ALLOW across all sources, so the ONLY way to neutralize an inherited allow is to affirmatively DENY it here — including interpreter/API escape hatches that could shell around a command-pattern deny. 'Appendix B's thinner sample' was unsafe precisely because it omitted those. Layer 2 (isolation step) runs this agent in a CLEAN worktree with NO settings.local.json so the most-permissive source is simply absent; secrets live in the process env (a dedicated capped ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, decision #5), not on disk. NEVER launch with --dangerously-skip-permissions (it bypasses every deny below). Git autonomy = add + commit ONLY; push/merge/PR are the founder's (decision #2). The agent cannot edit .claude/** so it cannot widen its own leash.
